framing: INTEGRATION-ROBUSTNESS check, NOT independent-cohort replication. The independent per-screen matrix (ScreenGeneEffect) shares 1177/1186 cell lines with the integrated Chronos discovery matrix (only 9 truly held out). A survivor replicating here confirms its signal is robust to the Chronos integration pipeline (raw per-screen effect vs integrated model); it does NOT prove replication in an independent patient/line cohort.
interpretation: All 53 mutation-testable survivors preserve direction and remain significant (p<0.05) in the per-screen matrix; Spearman rho of effect sizes = 0.97. This means none of the survivors is an artifact of Chronos integration. It is a necessary robustness condition, not sufficient clinical proof. CN axes (MTAP/CCNE1) are not re-testable here because CN calls are not in this matrix; they retain their expression-proxy CN detection from discovery.
